# spaceman artifacts

Move stored attachments, recordings and transcripts between the local disk and S3 (docs: site/operators/storage.md).

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman artifacts migrate`](#spaceman-artifacts-migrate) | Copy every stored artifact to the S3 bucket (artifacts.s3) or back to the local folders (offline: central must be stopped) |

## spaceman artifacts migrate

Copy every stored artifact to the S3 bucket (artifacts.s3) or back to the local folders (offline: central must be stopped).

Copies attachment content (its SHA-256 checked), recording segments and transcripts that the destination lacks, then optionally removes them from the source. It takes the data-directory lock, so central must be stopped, and it is safe to repeat after an interruption. Switch artifacts.backend afterwards and start central. Run it with --to s3 after restoring a backup into an installation whose artifacts.backend is s3: a restore writes artifacts to the local folders.

```sh
spaceman artifacts migrate --to s3|local [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | bool |  | only count what would be copied |
| `--json` | bool |  | print the report as JSON |
| `--remove-source` | bool |  | remove each artifact from the source once the destination holds it |
| `--to` | string |  | destination: s3 (the artifacts.s3 bucket) or local (the local folders) |
